F-DUPE.why_it_matters: Deterministic per token but arbitrary across tokens. The label is computed per-UUID while the customer sees a product CODE, so the bot makes a confidently WRONG factual claim about a product that demonstrably has 6 certificates. Today the bot makes no such claim ('Did you mean MWC7625-SH-S10?'), so this is the 'worse than today' mode the plan's F1 set out to avoid. It also breaks the pick round-trip: the pick is on the code string, so a correct '— has' can still resolve to the other uuid and dead-end.
F-DUPE.suggested_remedy_NOT_implemented: dym-transform dedups candidates by code for RENDERING; it should send EVERY uuid of a kept code to the probe (union), so has/no is answered at CODE level, matching what the customer is shown. Small, local to dym-transform. Alternative: fix the duplicate product rows in the CRM (out of scope here).
